notes.decision: Fits with guardrails under DI-50FF7AFF805C, recorded in the named-account amendment of the existing OAuth external build authority design. The chosen native Connect action confirms the named account instead of retaining the separate required checkbox and second action.
notes.owningArea: Platform authorization interstitial at /api/oauth/authorize; no navigation changes.
notes.persona: A signed-in person connecting an AI client who needs to recognize the account receiving the connection and approvals.
notes.reuse: Existing server-rendered native form, system colors, explicit approve/deny buttons and optional switch-account link. No new component or route.
notes.sourceTruth: The authenticated session supplies account identity. The unchanged POST compares confirm_account to the current session user ID and intersects scopes and coworker eligibility.
notes.states: Missing or stale identity issues no code and renders a fresh account choice. Cancel and a submission without an explicit approval remain refusals. Labels are escaped and the full account wraps.
notes.aiBoundary: No prompt send or automatic submission. The named native button is the explicit consent action.
notes.verification: On October31 current-main reconciliation,291 OAuth unit tests and web typecheck passed locally, preserving handover acknowledgement and automation-persona refusal. Served narrow-viewport, keyboard, light/dark checks and canonical first-connect/reconnect measurements remain required; this recorded decision is not browser acceptance.
